name: Hollywood Sign
desc: The 45-foot letters on Mount Lee are LA's most famous view. Hiking trails in Griffith Park and Lake Hollywood Park offer the best photo spots.
desc_zh: 矗立在李山上的巨型字母是洛杉矶最具代表性的景观，格里菲斯公园步道和好莱坞湖公园是最佳拍照点。
address: Mt Lee Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90068

name: Griffith Observatory
desc: Free-admission Art Deco observatory with public telescopes and sweeping views of the basin and the Hollywood Sign—a go-to sunset spot.
desc_zh: 免费参观的装饰艺术风格天文台，可用公共望远镜观星，俯瞰整个洛杉矶盆地和好莱坞标志，是看日落的热门地点。
address: 2800 E Observatory Rd, Los Angeles, CA 90027

name: Santa Monica Pier
desc: Century-old pier with Pacific Park's solar Ferris wheel, arcades and the symbolic end of Route 66, steps from Third Street Promenade.
desc_zh: 拥有百年历史的码头，有太平洋公园的太阳能摩天轮、游戏厅和66号公路终点标志，步行即达第三街步行街。
address: 200 Santa Monica Pier, Santa Monica, CA 90401

name: Getty Center
desc: Hilltop art museum in Brentwood with free admission, Richard Meier architecture, gardens and views from downtown to the ocean.
desc_zh: 位于布伦特伍德山顶的免费艺术博物馆，理查德·迈耶设计的建筑、花园和从市中心到海边的全景视野都很出名。
address: 1200 Getty Center Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90049

name: Walt Disney Concert Hall
desc: Frank Gehry's stainless-steel landmark and home of the LA Philharmonic, anchoring the Grand Avenue arts corridor on Bunker Hill.
desc_zh: 弗兰克·盖里设计的不锈钢地标，洛杉矶爱乐乐团的主场，是邦克山大道艺术走廊的核心。
address: 111 S Grand Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012

name: The Broad
desc: Free contemporary art museum known for its honeycomb facade and Infinity Mirror Rooms, right next to Disney Concert Hall.
desc_zh: 以蜂窝状外立面和草间弥生“无限镜屋”闻名的免费当代艺术馆，紧邻迪士尼音乐厅。
address: 221 S Grand Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012

name: Venice Beach Boardwalk
desc: Ocean Front Walk's street performers, Muscle Beach and skate park define Venice's laid-back vibe, with Abbot Kinney a short walk inland.
desc_zh: 海滨步道上的街头艺人、肌肉海滩和滑板公园构成了威尼斯海滩的悠闲氛围，往内陆走几分钟就是Abbot Kinney大道。

name: Rodeo Drive
desc: Beverly Hills' luxury shopping street, lined with flagship boutiques between Wilshire and Santa Monica Boulevards.
desc_zh: 比佛利山庄的奢侈品购物街，威尔希尔大道与圣莫尼卡大道之间汇集各大品牌旗舰店。
address: Rodeo Dr & Wilshire Blvd, Beverly Hills, CA 90210

name: Los Angeles Union Station
desc: LA's 1939 Mission Revival rail hub, connecting Metro rail, Amtrak and the FlyAway bus to LAX—handy for car-free commuting.
desc_zh: 建于1939年的西班牙传教风格火车总站，连接地铁、美铁和直达LAX的FlyAway巴士，无车通勤很方便。
address: 800 N Alameda St, Los Angeles, CA 90012

name: LACMA & Urban Light
desc: The largest art museum in the western US; Chris Burden's Urban Light lamp posts out front on Wilshire are a favorite photo stop.
desc_zh: 美国西部最大的艺术博物馆，门前威尔希尔大道上克里斯·伯顿的《城市之光》路灯装置是热门打卡点。

name: The Walt Disney Company (Burbank HQ)
desc: The Walt Disney Company's global headquarters on its historic Burbank studio lot, including the Team Disney building held up by the Seven Dwarfs.
desc_zh: 华特迪士尼公司全球总部所在的伯班克历史制片厂，园区内有以“七个小矮人”作立柱的Team Disney大楼。
address: 500 S Buena Vista St, Burbank, CA 91521

name: Warner Bros. Studios Burbank
desc: Warner Bros.' main studio lot, where many films and TV shows are made; offices, sound stages and the public Studio Tour Hollywood.
desc_zh: 华纳兄弟的主制片厂，大量电影和剧集在此拍摄，园区内有办公楼、摄影棚和对外开放的片场之旅。

credits.author: Tony Mariotti from Los Angeles, United States

name: Paramount Pictures Studios
desc: Paramount's historic lot on Melrose Avenue, the last major studio still operating in Hollywood itself, with offices and sound stages.
desc_zh: 派拉蒙位于梅尔罗斯大道的历史片场，是唯一仍在好莱坞本地运营的大型制片厂，内有办公区和摄影棚。

name: Sony Pictures Studios
desc: Sony Pictures Entertainment's headquarters on the former MGM lot in Culver City, with studios, offices and a walking tour.
desc_zh: 索尼影视娱乐总部，位于卡尔弗城原米高梅片场，包括摄影棚、办公楼和片场导览。
address: 10202 W Washington Blvd, Culver City, CA 90232

name: Amazon MGM Studios (The Culver Studios)
desc: Amazon MGM Studios' production campus at the historic Culver Studios, known for its colonial-style mansion facing Washington Blvd.
desc_zh: 亚马逊MGM影业的制作园区，位于历史悠久的卡尔弗制片厂，临华盛顿大道的殖民风格白色大宅是其标志。
address: 9336 W Washington Blvd, Culver City, CA 90232

name: SpaceX Headquarters
desc: SpaceX's Hawthorne rocket factory and longtime headquarters, where Falcon engines and Dragon capsules are built; a few minutes from LAX and El Segundo.
desc_zh: SpaceX位于霍桑的火箭工厂和长期总部，猎鹰发动机和龙飞船在此制造，距LAX和埃尔塞贡多仅几分钟车程。

name: United States Capitol
desc: Seat of Congress atop Capitol Hill; free guided tours start at the underground Visitor Center, and the surrounding rowhouse blocks are popular rentals.
desc_zh: 美国国会所在地，免费导览从地下游客中心出发；周边联排别墅街区是热门租房区域。

name: Lincoln Memorial
desc: Neoclassical memorial at the west end of the National Mall overlooking the Reflecting Pool—beautiful at sunrise and open 24/7.
desc_zh: 位于国家广场西端的新古典主义纪念堂，俯瞰倒影池，全天开放，日出时尤其美。
address: 2 Lincoln Memorial Cir NW, Washington, DC 20037

name: Washington Monument
desc: The 555-foot obelisk at the center of the Mall, with an elevator to an observation level; timed tickets are released online.
desc_zh: 国家广场中心高约169米的方尖碑，可乘电梯上观景层，需提前在网上预约限时门票。

name: The White House
desc: The President's home and office on Pennsylvania Avenue, best viewed from Lafayette Square to the north or the Ellipse to the south.
desc_zh: 位于宾夕法尼亚大道的总统官邸和办公地，北面的拉法叶广场和南面的椭圆草坪是最佳观赏位置。

name: Smithsonian National Museum of Natural History
desc: Free Smithsonian museum on the Mall famous for its rotunda elephant, dinosaur hall and the Hope Diamond.
desc_zh: 国家广场上的免费史密森尼博物馆，以圆厅大象、恐龙厅和“希望钻石”闻名。
address: 10th St & Constitution Ave NW, Washington, DC 20560

name: Georgetown Waterfront Park
desc: Riverside park along the Potomac with fountains, lawns and kayak rentals, next to the restaurants of Washington Harbour.
desc_zh: 沿波托马克河的滨水公园，有喷泉、草坪和皮划艇租赁，紧邻华盛顿港的餐厅区。

name: Washington Union Station
desc: Beaux-Arts rail hub for Amtrak, MARC, VRE and the Metro Red Line, steps from the Capitol and the NoMa apartment district.
desc_zh: 布杂艺术风格的交通枢纽，汇集美铁、MARC、VRE通勤铁路和地铁红线，步行可达国会和NoMa公寓区。

name: The Wharf
desc: Mile-long waterfront district on the Washington Channel with restaurants, music venues, piers and new apartments.
desc_zh: 沿华盛顿海峡约一英里长的滨水街区，餐厅、音乐场馆、码头和新建公寓林立。

name: Library of Congress
desc: The ornate Thomas Jefferson Building, the world's largest library, with its domed Main Reading Room; free to visit.
desc_zh: 华丽的托马斯·杰斐逊大楼是全球最大图书馆的主馆，圆顶主阅览室闻名，免费参观。

name: Nationals Park
desc: Home of the Washington Nationals on the Anacostia riverfront, the centerpiece of the fast-growing Navy Yard neighborhood.
desc_zh: 华盛顿国民队主场，位于阿纳科斯蒂亚河畔，是快速发展的海军船坞街区的核心。
address: 1500 S Capitol St SE, Washington, DC 20003

credits.author: All-Pro Reels from District of Columbia, USA

name: Amazon HQ2 (Metropolitan Park)
desc: Amazon's second headquarters at Metropolitan Park in National Landing: two office towers plus a public park and retail, near Pentagon City Metro.
desc_zh: 亚马逊第二总部，位于国家登陆区的大都会公园，包括两栋办公楼、公共公园和商铺，靠近五角大楼城地铁站。

name: World Bank Group
desc: Headquarters of the World Bank Group, the international development lender, a large employer of economists and analysts two blocks from the White House.
desc_zh: 国际发展贷款机构世界银行集团的总部，大量雇用经济学家和分析师，距白宫仅两个街区。

name: International Monetary Fund
desc: Headquarters of the International Monetary Fund, which oversees global monetary cooperation; its HQ1 and HQ2 buildings face each other on 19th St.
desc_zh: 负责全球货币合作的国际货币基金组织总部，HQ1与HQ2两栋大楼在19街相对而立。

name: The Washington Post
desc: The Washington Post's newsroom and offices at One Franklin Square on K Street, overlooking Franklin Park.
desc_zh: 《华盛顿邮报》位于K街富兰克林广场一号的编辑部和办公室，俯瞰富兰克林公园。

name: NPR Headquarters
desc: National Public Radio's headquarters and broadcast studios in NoMa, a short walk from Union Station.
desc_zh: 美国国家公共广播电台（NPR）总部及播音室，位于NoMa，步行可达联合车站。
address: 1111 North Capitol St NE, Washington, DC 20002

name: Willis Tower
desc: Chicago's tallest building, with the glass-floored Skydeck ledges on the 103rd floor and United Airlines' HQ inside.
desc_zh: 芝加哥最高建筑，103层有玻璃地板的Skydeck观景台，美国联合航空总部也在楼内。

name: Navy Pier
desc: Lakefront pier with the Centennial Wheel, boat tours and summer fireworks, at the edge of Streeterville.
desc_zh: 湖滨码头，有百年摩天轮、游船和夏季烟花，位于斯特里特维尔街区边缘。

credits.author: Matt Kieffer from London, United Kingdom

name: Wrigley Field
desc: The Cubs' ivy-walled ballpark from 1914, surrounded by Wrigleyville's bars and rooftop seats; the Red Line stops at Addison.
desc_zh: 建于1914年、外野爬满常春藤的小熊队主场，周边是瑞格利村的酒吧和屋顶看台，红线地铁Addison站直达。

credits.author: David Wilson from Oak Park, Illinois, USA

name: Art Institute of Chicago
desc: One of the top art museums in the US, guarded by bronze lions on Michigan Avenue; Illinois students get discounted admission.
desc_zh: 全美顶级艺术博物馆之一，密歇根大道门口有两座铜狮守护，伊利诺伊州学生可享门票优惠。

credits.author: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA

name: Millennium Park
desc: Downtown's front yard, with Frank Gehry's Pritzker Pavilion hosting free summer concerts, plus Cloud Gate and Crown Fountain.
desc_zh: 市中心的“前院”，弗兰克·盖里设计的普利兹克音乐亭夏季有免费音乐会，还有云门和皇冠喷泉。

credits.author: Carlos Felipe Pardo from Washington, United States

name: Chicago Riverwalk
desc: A walkway along the main branch of the Chicago River lined with cafés, kayak rentals and architecture boat tour docks.
desc_zh: 沿芝加哥河主干道的步道，咖啡馆、皮划艇租赁和建筑游船码头沿岸分布。
address: E Riverwalk S (Wacker Dr & State St), Chicago, IL 60601

credits.author: Mack Male from Edmonton, AB, Canada

name: Lincoln Park Zoo
desc: One of the oldest zoos in the country and still free, set in lakefront Lincoln Park near popular rental blocks.
desc_zh: 全美历史最悠久的动物园之一，至今免费开放，位于湖畔林肯公园，周边是热门租房街区。

name: Buckingham Fountain
desc: Grant Park's grand 1927 fountain, with hourly water shows from spring to fall and views of the Loop skyline.
desc_zh: 格兰特公园内建于1927年的大型喷泉，春季至秋季每小时有水景表演，可远眺卢普区天际线。

name: Chicago Union Station
desc: Chicago's main intercity rail station for Amtrak and Metra, famous for its Great Hall, on the river in the West Loop.
desc_zh: 芝加哥美铁和Metra通勤铁路的主要车站，以宏伟的大厅闻名，坐落在西卢普河畔。

credits.author: Raysonho @ Open Grid Scheduler / Scalable Grid Engine

name: CME Group (Chicago Mercantile Exchange Center)
desc: Headquarters of CME Group, the world's largest derivatives exchange operator, in twin towers on Wacker Drive along the river.
desc_zh: 全球最大衍生品交易所运营商芝商所（CME集团）总部，位于瓦克大道河畔的双子塔。

credits.author: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA

name: Kraft Heinz (Aon Center)
desc: The Aon Center, Chicago's third-tallest tower, houses the Chicago co-headquarters of food giant Kraft Heinz.
desc_zh: 芝加哥第三高楼怡安中心，食品巨头卡夫亨氏的芝加哥联合总部设在这里。

credits.author: Ken Lund from Reno, Nevada, USA

name: Cboe Global Markets (Old Post Office)
desc: The restored Old Post Office straddling the Eisenhower Expressway is now headquarters to exchange operator Cboe, alongside Walgreens and Uber offices.
desc_zh: 横跨艾森豪威尔高速公路的老邮政总局经翻修后，成为交易所运营商Cboe的总部，沃尔格林和Uber也在此办公。
address: 433 W Van Buren St, Chicago, IL 60607

name: Independence Hall
desc: Where the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution were debated and signed; free timed tours from the Independence Visitor Center.
desc_zh: 《独立宣言》和《美国宪法》的辩论与签署地，可在独立游客中心领取免费限时导览票。

credits.author: Gage Skidmore from Surprise, AZ, United States of America

name: Liberty Bell
desc: The cracked bell, an icon of American liberty, displayed for free in a glass pavilion facing Independence Hall.
desc_zh: 带裂痕的自由钟是美国自由的象征，免费陈列在正对独立厅的玻璃展馆中。

credits.author: Gage Skidmore from Surprise, AZ, United States of America
Gage Skidmore from Surprise, AZ, United States of America
Gage Skidmore from Surprise, AZ, United States of America

name: Philadelphia Museum of Art (Rocky Steps)
desc: Major art museum atop the steps Rocky ran up, at the end of the Benjamin Franklin Parkway beside the Schuylkill River.
desc_zh: 坐落在《洛奇》主角奔上的台阶顶端的大型艺术博物馆，位于富兰克林大道尽头、斯库基尔河畔。
neighborhood_zh: 费尔芒特 / 艺术博物馆区

credits.author: Gage Skidmore from Surprise, AZ, United States of America
Gage Skidmore from Surprise, AZ, United States of America
Gage Skidmore from Surprise, AZ, United States of America

name: Reading Terminal Market
desc: A historic indoor food market from 1893 with dozens of vendors—cheesesteaks, Amish baked goods and fresh produce—beside the Convention Center.
desc_zh: 始于1893年的室内美食市场，数十家摊位售卖芝士牛肉三明治、阿米什烘焙和新鲜农产品，紧邻会展中心。

name: Philadelphia City Hall
desc: The largest municipal building in the US, topped by a William Penn statue; its tower observation deck is open to visitors.
desc_zh: 全美最大的市政建筑，塔顶矗立威廉·佩恩雕像，塔楼观景台对游客开放。
address: 1400 John F Kennedy Blvd, Philadelphia, PA 19107

name: Rittenhouse Square
desc: Leafy square at the heart of Center City's most sought-after neighborhood, ringed by cafés, shops and high-rise apartments.
desc_zh: 中城最抢手街区中心的绿荫广场，周围环绕咖啡馆、商店和高层公寓。
address: W Rittenhouse Sq & Walnut St, Philadelphia, PA 19103

name: Elfreth's Alley
desc: Often called the oldest continuously inhabited residential street in the US, a cobbled lane of 18th-century rowhouses in Old City.
desc_zh: 被誉为美国历史最悠久且一直有人居住的街道，老城区内铺满鹅卵石、两旁是18世纪联排房屋。

name: Boathouse Row
desc: Historic rowing clubhouses on the Schuylkill River, outlined in lights at night; a popular jogging and biking stretch.
desc_zh: 斯库基尔河畔的历史赛艇俱乐部建筑群，夜晚轮廓灯亮起，是慢跑和骑行的热门路线。

name: 30th Street Station
desc: Philadelphia's main Amtrak and SEPTA Regional Rail hub, a 1930s landmark at the edge of University City.
desc_zh: 费城美铁和SEPTA区域铁路的主要枢纽，20世纪30年代的地标建筑，位于大学城边缘。

name: LOVE Park
desc: JFK Plaza, home of Robert Indiana's LOVE sculpture, framed by City Hall and the Parkway; holiday markets set up nearby.
desc_zh: 肯尼迪广场，罗伯特·印第安纳的LOVE雕塑所在地，正对市政厅和富兰克林大道，节日期间周边有集市。
address: 1599 John F Kennedy Blvd, Philadelphia, PA 19102

name: Comcast Center (Comcast HQ)
desc: Comcast's global headquarters, a 58-story glass tower on JFK Boulevard with a public lobby and concourse dining.
desc_zh: 康卡斯特全球总部，肯尼迪大道上58层的玻璃大楼，设有对外开放的大堂和地下美食街。
address: 1701 John F Kennedy Blvd, Philadelphia, PA 19103

name: Comcast Technology Center
desc: Philadelphia's tallest building, home to Comcast's technology and media teams with a Four Seasons hotel on top.
desc_zh: 费城最高建筑，康卡斯特技术与媒体团队的办公地，顶层是四季酒店。

name: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia
desc: Children's Hospital of Philadelphia, a leading pediatric hospital and research center on the University City medical campus.
desc_zh: 费城儿童医院，全美领先的儿科医院和研究中心，位于大学城医疗园区。

name: Cigna (Two Liberty Place)
desc: Two Liberty Place, the 58-story Center City tower that has long housed health insurer Cigna's main Philadelphia offices.
desc_zh: 中城58层的二号自由广场大楼，长期是医疗保险公司信诺（Cigna）在费城的主要办公地。

name: Capitol Records Building (Capitol Music Group)
desc: The round tower near Hollywood & Vine houses Capitol Music Group, part of Universal Music Group, with its famous recording studios.
desc_zh: 好莱坞与藤街口附近的圆形大楼，是环球音乐集团旗下国会音乐集团的办公地，并拥有著名的录音室。
address: 1750 N Vine St, Los Angeles, CA 90028

name: Cedars-Sinai Medical Center
desc: Major nonprofit academic medical center and one of LA's largest employers, on the edge of Beverly Hills and West Hollywood.
desc_zh: 大型非营利学术医疗中心，洛杉矶最大的雇主之一，位于比佛利山庄与西好莱坞交界处。
neighborhood_zh: 比佛利格罗夫（毗邻比佛利山庄）

name: National Geographic Headquarters
desc: National Geographic's headquarters campus at 17th and M Streets, home to the Society and its public museum.
desc_zh: 国家地理位于17街与M街交口的总部园区，国家地理学会及其对外开放的博物馆都在这里。

name: Inter-American Development Bank
desc: Headquarters of the Inter-American Development Bank, the main development lender for Latin America and the Caribbean, near Metro Center.
desc_zh: 美洲开发银行总部，拉美和加勒比地区最主要的发展贷款机构，靠近Metro Center地铁站。
address: 1300 New York Ave NW, Washington, DC 20577

name: Conagra Brands (Merchandise Mart)
desc: The massive Art Deco Merchandise Mart houses Conagra Brands' headquarters plus tech offices and showrooms, with its own Brown/Purple Line stop.
desc_zh: 巨型装饰艺术风格建筑商品市场大楼，康尼格拉品牌总部及多家科技公司和展厅在此，设有棕线/紫线专属地铁站。
address: 222 W Merchandise Mart Plaza, Chicago, IL 60654

credits.author: Mack Male from Edmonton, AB, Canada
Chris Rycroft from Madison, Wisconsin, United States

name: Accenture Tower
desc: Glass tower above Ogilvie Transportation Center that hosts Accenture's Chicago offices—Metra trains run right underneath.
desc_zh: 位于奥格尔维交通中心上方的玻璃大楼，埃森哲芝加哥办公室所在地，Metra通勤火车就从楼下驶过。

credits.author: Tony Webster from Portland, Oregon, United States
Tony Webster from Portland, Oregon, United States
Tony Webster from Portland, Oregon, United States

name: Rush University Medical Center
desc: Rush University Medical Center, a major academic hospital in the Illinois Medical District, known for its butterfly-shaped tower.
desc_zh: 拉什大学医学中心，伊利诺伊医疗区内的大型学术医院，以蝴蝶形大楼著称。

name: Penn Medicine – Pennsylvania Hospital
desc: Founded in 1751 as the nation's first hospital, Pennsylvania Hospital is part of Penn Medicine, one of the city's largest employers.
desc_zh: 宾夕法尼亚医院建于1751年，是美国第一家医院，现属费城最大雇主之一的宾大医疗体系。

name: Jefferson Health – Thomas Jefferson University
desc: Center City campus of Thomas Jefferson University and its flagship Jefferson Health hospital, one of Philadelphia's largest employers.
desc_zh: 托马斯·杰斐逊大学及其旗下杰斐逊医疗旗舰医院的中城园区，是费城最大的雇主之一。
neighborhood_zh: 东市场街 / 华盛顿广场西

name: Fox Studio Lot (Fox Corporation)
desc: Fox Corporation's historic studio lot in Century City, home to Fox offices and Disney's 20th Century Studios productions.
desc_zh: 福克斯公司位于世纪城的历史片场，福克斯办公室及迪士尼旗下20世纪影业的制作团队都在这里。
